text.p: Shares in Pakistan Telecommunications Company Ltd (PTCL) dropped 1.70 rupees, or 4.86 percent, to 33.30 on Thursday on news of the flotation of its $150 million five-year bond, dealers said.
A turnover over of 460,500 shares of PTCL was recorded at the Karachi bourse by midsession.
"Rates of PTCL are down on news of the flotation of its $150 million bond," said Mudassar Malik, chief dealer of BMA Capital Management.
"People expect PTCL prices to slip on selling of its GDR (global depositary receipts) after the flotation of bond."
He said the donwslide in PTCL rates would be temorary as the company's fundamentals were not changed. "People are pre-empting the news."
The London-based Nomura International Plc has said the $150 million bond, exchangeable into shares of the state-run PTCL, would be floated shortly.
The bond would be listed at the Luxembourg Stock Exchange and investors will have the option to exchange them into common stock listed in Pakistan into GDRs.
